candidate_description: Selected experimental GPUJPEG binary; the label is an alias, and recorded CMake options identify the actual compact/unstuff feature configuration.

boundary_notes.primary: With the QPC helper: CONTINUOUS actual Fastvideo memory-stream header-load QPC START through codec completed-download QPC STOP vs GPUJPEG Decode Image. This includes the intervening host gap and excludes the cached initial disk-read time that Fastvideo adds to every printed JFIF-load value. Without the QPC helper Fastvideo printed load+codec is INVALID as per-frame latency.
boundary_notes.GPUJPEG_reported: Host wall time: JPEG parsing, decoder work, H2D and synchronous output D2H; no input/output file I/O.
boundary_notes.Fastvideo_reported: Printed Decode time + Device-To-Host time. Native QPC brackets SDK decode, processing and synchronous output download, excludes JPEG header/SOS loading. Includes no-RST host entropy transcode.
boundary_notes.Fastvideo_plus_load: INVALID for per-frame latency: the printed JFIF-load value equals actual per-repeat memory parsing/copy time plus a cached one-time initial disk-load charge. Native bytes add node+0x6c at0x1400072fc. Retained only as a diagnostic; use direct QPC observations for the complete-memory primary interval.
boundary_notes.process_wall: Python perf_counter around child execution until process exit: initialization, all iterations, input parsing/I/O, final output write, console printing and cleanup. Wall/iterations amortizes these costs; first iterations remain included.
boundary_notes.warmup: Discard the first warmup samples within each process, independently per variant.
boundary_notes.output: Returned CPU image bytes and final P5/P6 output required. No Fastvideo -discard. Output channel count and pixel-byte size checked.
boundary_notes.environment: Sequential child runs, rotating variant order; corpus SHA256 verified. File-cache warmness uncontrolled beyond reading/hash-checking every input before runs. No GPU clock locking.
